QuestInfo.name: An Old Ring
QuestInfo.parent: In Search of the Book of Ancient
QuestInfo.1: You found someone's tomb in the Snowfield Valley and took an old ring from the corpse's finger. #bSergeant Bravo#k near the tomb seems to know something about the ring.
QuestInfo.2: You handed the ring over to Sergeant Bravo.
QuestInfo.summary: Ask #bSergeant Bravo#k about the ring. He is near the graves.
QuestInfo.0: Check out the Small Tomb in the Icy Cold Field.

0.0: Dug up the small tomb, and found a shining object on the finger of a corpse. Will you stretch your arm out and take the item from it?

yes.0: The item taken from the finger of a corpse is an #b#t4031053##k that seems to have been around for a long time.

npc.0: In the tomb there was some moss, a corpse, and not much else. Looked further in but still found nothing.

lost.0: When you carefully examine the small dug up grave, you notice that a shiny ring has been placed on the skeleton's finger again. Will you put your hands inside to remove the ring?
